source_family: Same six roles; FS8,DMS9,DB-reuse3,global3 with unchanged map3/memory2
carrier: Same fixed mechanical kernel raw syscall ABI and immutable request/ACK layout. No script, database, path-policy or retry branch exists in the mechanical carrier.

new_or_newly_connected_operations.name: OPENAT_WITH_FD
new_or_newly_connected_operations.contract: Same existing OPENAT arguments and full extent/NUL checks; FS issues the logical token and additionally returns actual numeric fd at result+72. fd0 remains valid.

new_or_newly_connected_operations.name: GETPID
new_or_newly_connected_operations.contract: Actual native process PID; no host PID receipt. HIA validates positive signed-int range and returns it.

new_or_newly_connected_operations.name: ACCESS
new_or_newly_connected_operations.contract: Actual access(path, mode) with real UID semantics and exact C pathname. No permission result is synthesized. Normal mode0..7 remains HIA policy.

new_or_newly_connected_operations.name: OPENAT_CSTR_WITH_FD
new_or_newly_connected_operations.contract: Like25, additionally admits zero content bytes, emits the actual one-byte NUL buffer, and retains the real kernel result.

new_or_newly_connected_operations.name: STATAT_CSTR
new_or_newly_connected_operations.contract: Like existing18 STATAT, additionally permits zero content bytes. Success yields original144-byte stat plus exact duplicate fields; error payload is empty.

old_1_through24: All original syscall numbers, argument mapping, lease, token, no-retry, close consumption, result and guard rules retained.
global_reuse: The existing HIA global directory still skips STAT when empty. With a nonempty directory it invokes existing op18 for nonempty C paths and actual op29 for the zero-byte C path. A real failed stat is a miss. The same pending reply/generation/source and token-consumption rules remain mandatory.
barriers: DMS accepts the new generic gateway numbers but retains internal-FD protection and the same sole shared-FS issuer. The global outer retains registered DB token protection. Tokens are not raw FD integers or externally authenticated headers.
open_scope: Actual robust-open and create-mode callers must still be composed with the global open controller; raw gateway success is not full unixOpen success.
Full PID/URI/temp/allocator fallback/verifyDbFile warning sequence not closed.
